panels.name: 90%-ile Latency (millisecs) by Origin Host
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly 
| json "request_user_agent", "time_elapsed", "url","geo_region","geo_country_code","client_ip","status", "origin_host", "cache_status" as user_agent, time_elapsed, url, geo_region, geo_country_code, src_ip, status, origin_host, cache_status
| time_elapsed/1000 as time_elapsed
| timeslice 1m
| where cache_status = "MISS" or cache_status = "PASS"
| pct(time_elapsed, 90) as nintieth by origin_host, _timeslice
| transpose row _timeslice column origin_host

panels.name: Median Latency (millisecs) by Origin Host
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly 
| json "request_user_agent", "time_elapsed", "url","geo_region","geo_country_code","client_ip","status", "origin_host", "cache_status" as user_agent, time_elapsed, url, geo_region, geo_country_code, src_ip, status, origin_host, cache_status
| time_elapsed/1000 as time_elapsed // convert to millisecs
| timeslice 1m
| where cache_status = "MISS" or cache_status = "PASS"
| pct(time_elapsed, 50) as nintieth by origin_host, _timeslice
| transpose row _timeslice column origin_host

panels.name: Slowest URLs (millisecs)
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly 
| json "request_user_agent", "time_elapsed", "url","geo_region","geo_country_code","client_ip","status","cache_status" as user_agent, time_elapsed, url, geo_region, geo_country_code, src_ip, status, cache_status
| urldecode(url) as url 
| time_elapsed/1000 as time_elapsed // convert to millisecs
| where cache_status = "MISS" or cache_status = "PASS"
| max(time_elapsed) as max_time_elapsed by url
| sort by max_time_elapsed
| limit 10

panels.name: Origin Content Download Time (millisecs) Histogram
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly 
| json "request_user_agent", "time_elapsed", "url","geo_region","geo_country_code","client_ip","cache_status", "status" as user_agent, time_elapsed, url, geo_region, geo_country_code, src_ip, cache_status, status
| where cache_status = "MISS" or cache_status = "PASS"
| time_elapsed/1000 as time_elapse // convert to milliseconds
| 100 as bucket_size // use 0.1 second as the bucket size
| floor(time_elapsed/bucket_size)*bucket_size as response_time
| format("%.0f-%.0f",floor(time_elapsed/bucket_size)*bucket_size,ceil(time_elapsed/bucket_size)*bucket_size) as response_time_str
| if (response_time > 10*bucket_size, format(">%.0f",10*bucket_size),response_time_str) as response_time
| count as requests by response_time 
| sort by + response_time

panels.name: Error Rate 4xx by Code
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly 4??
| json "request_user_agent", "time_elapsed", "url","geo_region","geo_country_code","client_ip","request","status","origin_host" as user_agent, time_elapsed, url, geo_region, geo_country_code, src_ip, method, status, origin_host   
| where status matches "4*" and method = "GET"
| timeslice 10m as _timeslice
| count by _timeslice, status
| transpose row _timeslice column status

panels.name: Top 5XX Error-Causing URLs
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly 50?
| json "request_user_agent", "time_elapsed", "url","geo_region","geo_country_code","client_ip","status" as user_agent, time_elapsed, url, geo_region, geo_country_code, src_ip, status
| urldecode(url) as url 
| where status > 499
| where status < 600
| count as errors by url
| sort by errors

panels.name: Top 404-Causing URLs
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly 
| json "request_user_agent", "time_elapsed", "url","geo_region","geo_country_code","client_ip","status" as user_agent, time_elapsed, url, geo_region, geo_country_code, src_ip, status
| urldecode(url) as url
| where status = 404
| count as errors by url | sort by errors | limit 25

panels.name: Error Rate 5xx
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly 5??
| json "request_user_agent", "time_elapsed", "url","geo_region","geo_country_code","client_ip","status", "request" as user_agent, time_elapsed, url, geo_region, geo_country_code, src_ip, status, method 
| where status matches "5*" and method="GET"
| timeslice 10m as _timeslice
| count by _timeslice, status
| transpose row _timeslice column status

panels.name: Visitor Geolocations
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly 
| json "request_user_agent", "time_elapsed", "url","geo_region","geo_country_code","client_ip","status" as user_agent, time_elapsed, url, geo_region, geo_country_code, src_ip, status
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code from geo://location on ip = src_ip
| count_distinct(src_ip) by latitude, longitude

panels.name: Download Performance Hotspots - Avg Download Above 300ms by Country
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly 
| json "request_user_agent", "time_elapsed", "url","geo_region","geo_country_code","client_ip","status" as user_agent, time_elapsed, url, geo_region, geo_country_code, src_ip, status
| lookup latitude, longitude from geo://location on ip=src_ip 
| count as numhits, avg(time_elapsed) as avg_time_elapsed by geo_country_code, latitude, longitude 
| round(avg_time_elapsed)
| where avg_time_elapsed > 300000 and numhits > 1| sort by avg_time_elapsed

panels.name: Visitor Countries
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly
| json "request_user_agent", "time_elapsed", "url","geo_region","geo_country_code","client_ip","status" as user_agent, time_elapsed, url, geo_region, geo_country_code, src_ip, status
| count by geo_country_code

panels.name: Top 404-Causing URLs
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly 
| json "request_user_agent", "time_elapsed", "url","geo_region","geo_country_code","client_ip","status" as user_agent, time_elapsed, url, geo_region, geo_country_code, src_ip, status
| urldecode(url) as url
| where status = 404
| count as errors by url | sort by errors | limit 25

panels.name: Top Server Error-Causing URLs
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly 
| json "request_user_agent", "time_elapsed", "url","geo_region","geo_country_code","client_ip","status" as user_agent, time_elapsed, url, geo_region, geo_country_code, src_ip, status
| urldecode(url) as url | int(status) as status
| where (status > 499) and (status < 600)
| count as errors by url | sort by errors | limit 25

panels.name: Origin Download 90%-ile Latency (Microsecs)
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly 
| json "request_user_agent", "time_elapsed", "url","geo_region","geo_country_code","client_ip","status", "origin_host", "cache_status" as user_agent, time_elapsed, url, geo_region, geo_country_code, src_ip, status, origin_host, cache_status
| timeslice 1m
| where cache_status = "MISS" or cache_status = "PASS"
| pct(time_elapsed, 90) as nintieth by origin_host, _timeslice
| transpose row _timeslice column origin_host

panels.name: Cache Hit Percentage Over Time
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly    
| json "request_user_agent", "time_elapsed", "url","geo_region","geo_country_code","client_ip", "cache_status" as user_agent, time_elapsed, url, geo_region, geo_country_code, src_ip, cache_status 
| if (cache_status = "HIT", 1,0) as cache_offload
| timeslice 5m
| count as totalCount, sum(cache_offload) as cache_offload by _timeslice 
| toInt((cache_offload/totalCount)*100) as CacheOffloadPct | fields -totalCount,cache_offload

panels.name: Download Performance Hotspots - Avg Download Above 300ms
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly   
| json "request_user_agent", "time_elapsed", "url","geo_region","geo_country_code","client_ip" as user_agent, time_elapsed, url, geo_region, geo_country_code, src_ip 
| lookup latitude, longitude from geo://location on ip=src_ip
| count as numhits, avg(time_elapsed) as avg_time_elapsed by geo_country_code, latitude, longitude | round(avg_time_elapsed)
| where avg_time_elapsed > 300000 and numhits > 1| sort by avg_time_elapsed

panels.name: Cache Hit Percentage Over Time
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly    
| json "request_user_agent", "time_elapsed", "url","geo_region","geo_country_code","client_ip", "cache_status" as user_agent, time_elapsed, url, geo_region, geo_country_code, src_ip, cache_status 
| if (cache_status = "HIT", 1,0) as cache_offload
| timeslice 5m
| count as totalCount, sum(cache_offload) as cache_offload by _timeslice 
| toInt((cache_offload/totalCount)*100) as CacheOffloadPct | fields -totalCount,cache_offload

panels.name: Overall Content Download Time (millisecs) Histogram
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly 
| json "request_user_agent", "time_elapsed", "url","geo_region","geo_country_code","client_ip","cache_status", "status" as user_agent, time_elapsed, url, geo_region, geo_country_code, src_ip, cache_status, status
| time_elapsed/1000 as time_elapsed // convert to msecs
| 100 as bucket_size // use 0.1 second as the bucket size
| floor(time_elapsed/bucket_size)*bucket_size as response_time
| format("%6.0f-%6.0f",floor(time_elapsed/bucket_size)*bucket_size,ceil(time_elapsed/bucket_size)*bucket_size) as response_time_str
| if (response_time > 10*bucket_size, format(">%6.0f",10*bucket_size),response_time_str) as response_time
| count as requests by response_time 
| sort by + response_time

panels.name: Performance (millisecs) Stats by Country
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly   
| json "request_user_agent", "time_elapsed", "url","geo_region","geo_country_code","client_ip","cache_status" as user_agent, time_elapsed, url, geo_region, geo_country_code, src_ip , cache_status
| if (cache_status = "HIT", 1,0) as cache_offload
| time_elapsed/1000 as time_elapsed // convert to millisecs
| count as requests, sum(cache_offload) as cache_offload, pct(time_elapsed, 5) as pct_5, pct(time_elapsed, 25) as lowerq, pct(time_elapsed, 50) as median, pct(time_elapsed, 75) as upperq, pct(time_elapsed, 95) as pct_95,avg(time_elapsed) as average by geo_country_code
| round(cache_offload*100/requests) as hit_pct | fields -cache_offload 
| round(pct_5) | round(lowerq)| round(median)| round(upperq)| round(pct_95)| round(average)
| sort by average

panels.name: Performance (millisecs) Stats by Data Center
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly   
| json "request_user_agent", "time_elapsed", "url","geo_region","geo_country_code","client_ip","cache_status","geo_datacenter" as user_agent, time_elapsed, url, geo_region, geo_country_code, src_ip , cache_status, geo_datacenter
| if (cache_status = "HIT", 1,0) as cache_offload
| time_elapsed/1000 as time_elapsed // convert to millisecs
| count as requests, sum(cache_offload) as cache_offload, pct(time_elapsed, 5) as pct_5, pct(time_elapsed, 25) as lowerq, pct(time_elapsed, 50) as median, pct(time_elapsed, 75) as upperq, pct(time_elapsed, 95) as pct_95,avg(time_elapsed) as average by geo_datacenter
| round(cache_offload*100/requests) as hit_pct | fields -cache_offload 
| round(pct_5) | round(lowerq)| round(median)| round(upperq)| round(pct_95)| round(average)
| sort by average

panels.name: Cacheable Content Download Time (millisecs) Histogram
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly 
| json "request_user_agent", "time_elapsed", "url","geo_region","geo_country_code","client_ip","cache_status", "status" as user_agent, time_elapsed, url, geo_region, geo_country_code, src_ip, cache_status, status
| where cache_status = "HIT" or cache_status = "MISS"
| time_elapsed/1000 as time_elapse // convert to milliseconds
| 100 as bucket_size // use 0.1 second as the bucket size
| floor(time_elapsed/bucket_size)*bucket_size as response_time
| format("%.0f-%.0f",floor(time_elapsed/bucket_size)*bucket_size,ceil(time_elapsed/bucket_size)*bucket_size) as response_time_str
| if (response_time > 10*bucket_size, format(">%.0f",10*bucket_size),response_time_str) as response_time
| count as requests by response_time 
| sort by + response_time

_sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly    
| json "request_user_agent", "time_elapsed", "url","geo_region","geo_country_code","client_ip","req_header_size","resp_body_size" as user_agent, time_elapsed, url, geo_region, geo_country_code, src_ip,req_header_size,resp_body_size 
| timeslice 1h
| count as totalCount, sum(req_header_size) as req_header_size,sum(resp_body_size) as resp_body_size by _timeslice  
| req_header_size + resp_body_size as total_resp_size 
| fields -totalCount,req_header_size,resp_body_size

panels.name: Top 10 Referrers
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly    
| json "request_user_agent", "time_elapsed", "url","geo_region","geo_country_code","client_ip", "request_referer" as user_agent, time_elapsed, url, geo_region, geo_country_code, src_ip, request_referer  
| count by request_referer | top 10 request_referer by _count

panels.name: Top Requests
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly  
| json "request_user_agent", "time_elapsed", "url","geo_region","geo_country_code","client_ip","status" as user_agent, time_elapsed, url, geo_region, geo_country_code, src_ip, status
| urldecode(url) as url
| count by url | top 10 url by _count

panels.name: Bot Traffic Over Time
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly (*bot* or *index*)
| json "request_user_agent", "time_elapsed", "url","geo_region","geo_country_code","client_ip","status" as user_agent, time_elapsed, url, geo_region, geo_country_code, src_ip, status
| timeslice 1m
| urldecode(user_agent) as user_agent
| where user_agent matches "*bot*" or user_agent matches "*index*"
| count by user_agent, _timeslice//,evolution,version
| transpose row _timeslice column user_agent
